title: Hong Kong insurer OneDegree reports hacker breach; PCPD investigating
date_note: i-Cable's report of 24 Nov says OneDegree announced the breach 'last week' without giving a day; the page's publication day is used.
geo_basis: Virtual insurer operating in Hong Kong; city-level pin, no office location stated
summary: i-Cable reports that Hong Kong virtual insurer OneDegree was breached by hackers, with affected customers numbering 11萬 (its own figure). Some customers' ID card numbers, photos and bank account numbers were taken; credit card data was not involved, according to the report. The Privacy Commissioner's office said it received a notification last Thursday and has opened an investigation.
plain: A Hong Kong online insurer was hacked, and i-Cable reports many customers were affected. The privacy regulator is investigating.
exec: A customer-data breach at an insurer, reported by i-Cable, has drawn a regulator investigation.

evidence.quote: 虛擬保險公司OneDegree被駭客入侵，受影響客戶達11萬人。

validation.note: Only i-Cable read; OneDegree's own announcement and the PCPD notice were not found by search.
